## Brief

This is a website created for the fictional company AvtoZeichen (from Russian "Avto" for "auto" and German "Zeichen" for "\[traffic\] signal/sign"). The company is imagined to specialise in IoT technology for transportation e.g. smart traffic signs/lights and devices for easing traffic jams. The company has consulted our student team of three to design a landing website that aesthetically presents the company's info and current job positions, with a form for users to submit career expressions of interest (EOIs).

> **Update**
> - In March 2026, I have reused this website for a personal assignment in a different unit.
